scope: Independent deterministic companion integration after the finite-reference audit found no beta>0 draws; no new MCMC or speed experiment
coordinate_rule: Find a stationary point from [0,0] using the analytical NumPy gradient; use the inverse observed-information Cholesky factor for fixed integration coordinates.
integration: Tensor Gauss-Legendre in the whitened square [-R,R]^2; beta>0 integrated separately with a variable lower z2 boundary and z1 intervals split where that boundary crosses +/-R.
tail_control: Global log-concavity supporting planes on radius-R directions bound omitted mass outside the square by a sector-wise integral outside the inscribed disk; also bound absolute polynomial moment tails.
error_interpretation: Report every order/radius result, order and domain differences, and floating-point evaluations of analytic tail inequalities. No interval arithmetic is implemented; grid stability and evaluated tail bounds are not a certified total quadrature error or exact truth.
selected_summary: Report the preselected largest radius and order (12,96), not the combination agreeing best with MCMC. Retain all smaller-grid values.
reference_comparison: Compare the six continuous means to the finite reference with its MCSE. For beta>0, report numerical integration separately from the undetermined finite-MCMC reference uncertainty; no independent-Bernoulli approximation.
guards: Fresh output only; immutable upstream hashes; finite root/gradient and positive definite information; each rule at most 100000 nodes, chunk at most 128; nonnegative finite integrals; no total runtime cutoff.
